chars.BADR: BADR: an athletic young man wearing a fitted black hoodie with one thick white stripe across the chest, olive green jogger trousers and white sneakers.
chars.HIBA: HIBA: a slim young woman wearing a shiny red satin bomber jacket over a cream top, black wide-leg trousers and gold hoop earrings.
chars.FRIENDS: FRIENDS: two young party guests, one man in a yellow shirt and one woman in a teal dress.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night party in a modern apartment living room in Rabat with colored string lights. HIBA dances and laughs happily in the middle holding a plastic cup, the FRIENDS cheer around her.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: At the party, the FRIENDS lean in to hug and kiss HIBA on the cheek, but HIBA politely steps back and just waves her hand with a friendly smile, keeping her distance.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: At the party, HIBA sways a little, slightly tipsy, holding a cup and smiling. BADR stands calmly near the wall holding a water bottle, watching her with a curious look.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Late night on an empty Rabat street with street lamps and a red Rabat petit taxi. HIBA, tired, gets into the taxi to go home after the party.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: BADR's dark bedroom at night, he sits on his bed in the dark, his face lit by the glowing phone screen in his hand, surprised by a new message notification. Dumbbells on the floor.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: HIBA's bedroom at night, she sits on her bed hugging her knees, typing on her phone with a nervous, shy and worried expression, soft lamp light.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Close-up medium shot of BADR in his dark bedroom staring at his glowing phone with wide shocked eyes and open mouth, frozen, not knowing what to answer.
